coverage_scope.included: All VLSIT-authored/generated production RTL under rtl/common/vlsit plus every RTL file proven modified in rtl/common/modified against its pinned upstream baseline. Final exact file list and baseline hashes are frozen in the approved package before simulation.
coverage_scope.third_party: 343 active source files are under third_party paths and are candidates for reuse, not automatically excluded. Before any credited run, compare each file to the exact pinned upstream revision; every locally modified file joins the 100% threshold. Only proven unchanged licensed files are reported separately with no threshold.
coverage_scope.testbench: Verification code, BFMs, models and test-only wrappers are not part of DUT code coverage denominator.
